name: Navratna Kalp Amrit Ras

sections.introduction: Navratna Kalp Amrit Ras is an Ayurvedic formulation in the form of tablets. It is a superior rejuvenative. This formulation treats Vata disorders. It strengthens heart, brain, kidneys. Navratna Kalp Amrit Ras detoxifies the body effectively and treats piles, diabetes, respiratory disorders and many more disorders.
sections.ingredients:
Manikya pishti 
 Neelam pishti 
 Panna pishti 
 Pukhraj pishti 
 Vaidurya pishti 
 Gomed Bhasma 
 Mukta pishti 
 Ropya Bhasma 
 Rajavrat Bhasma 
 Praval pishti 
 Swarn Bhasma 
 Lauha Bhasma 
 Yashad Bhasma 
 Abhrak Bhasma 
 Purified guggul 
 Purified Shilajit 
 Guduchi 
 Cow’s milk clarified butter 

 Method of Preparation 
 Mix the bhasmas and pishti and crush it using a mortar pestle by adding clarified butter in tiny proportions. Then add Tinospora and guggul to the mortar and keep adding clarified butter and add the bhasma gradually. Soak Shilajit in water and mix it well and add to the mortar as well. Combine it till a paste like consistency is formed and make 125 mg tablets each and let them dry. After the pills are completely dry, store them in an air tight container.

fullContent:
Navratna Kalp Amrit Ras 
 Reference: Ayurveda Sarsangraha. 
 Introduction 
 Navratna Kalp Amrit Ras is an Ayurvedic formulation in the form of tablets. It is a superior rejuvenative. This formulation treats Vata disorders. It strengthens heart, brain, kidneys. Navratna Kalp Amrit Ras detoxifies the body effectively and treats piles, diabetes, respiratory disorders and many more disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Manikya pishti 
 Neelam pishti 
 Panna pishti 
 Pukhraj pishti 
 Vaidurya pishti 
 Gomed Bhasma 
 Mukta pishti 
 Ropya Bhasma 
 Rajavrat Bhasma 
 Praval pishti 
 Swarn Bhasma 
 Lauha Bhasma 
 Yashad Bhasma 
 Abhrak Bhasma 
 Purified guggul 
 Purified Shilajit 
 Guduchi 
 Cow’s milk clarified butter 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Mix the bhasmas and pishti and crush it using a mortar pestle by adding clarified butter in tiny proportions. Then add Tinospora and guggul to the mortar and keep adding clarified butter and add the bhasma gradually. Soak Shilajit in water and mix it well and add to the mortar as well. Combine it till a paste like consistency is formed and make 125 mg tablets each and let them dry. After the pills are completely dry, store them in an air tight container. 
 Dosage 
 1 to 2 pills twice daily after meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Bleeding disorders 
 Piles 
 Tuberculosis 
 Bronchitis 
 Urinary disorders 
 Bloating 
 Flatulence 
 Cardiac disorders 
 Diarrhea 
 Drowsiness 
 Insomnia 
 Dyspnea 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage is discouraged. 
 Self-medication should be avoided. 
 It should be taken under strict medical supervision during pregnancy, lactation and in children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
